howToPlay.heading: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Merge coins in order to get the SP.
howToPlay.chain: Copper -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> Ruby -> Amethyst -> Platinum -> Emerald -> Queen -> Sapphire -> Diamond -> SP.
howToPlay.specialRule: Bring 3 SP coins into contact with each other and they explode: earning an extra points bonus and freeing up space in the jar to keep playing.
